summary: Gate 8 re-review (iteration 3) of PR #77 (NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability). All 5 prior findings (B1, B2, M1, M2, M3) verified as RESOLVED. 1 new blocking issue found: B3 — idb production dependency is missing from package.json. The production code in dbSchema.ts imports from idb but the dependency is not listed in package.json dependencies. Only fake-indexeddb and globals were added to devDependencies. The app will fail to build without idb.

prior_findings_status.M1: RESOLVED — ResumePrompt.test.tsx and useAutoSave.test.ts import real production modules
prior_findings_status.M2: RESOLVED — console.warn added to persistenceService.ts catch block
prior_findings_status.M3: RESOLVED — console.warn added to all 4 catch blocks in persistenceStore.ts

blocking.title: idb production dependency missing from package.json
blocking.description: Production code in dbSchema.ts (line 14) imports from idb library: import { openDB, type IDBPDatabase, type DBSchema } from 'idb'. However, idb is not listed in package.json dependencies. Only fake-indexeddb and globals were added to devDependencies. The application will fail to build and run without this dependency.
blocking.impact: Build failure — all 6 production modules depend on dbSchema.ts which imports idb. The entire auto-save feature is non-functional without this dependency.
blocking.fix: Add '"idb": "^8.0.0"' to the dependencies section of frontend/package.json.
